title: Truthful state transitions
implementerFace: Design every terminal state so error, unknown, skipped, and pending never coerce into success. Map provider outcomes one-to-one, surface reason codes, and write a negative test for each false-success path.
reviewerFace: Hunt false-success paths: empty plans accepted as completed, dry-run reporting published, skipped/unknown mapped to pass, or missing observations treated as green. Require observed behavior for every success claim.

title: Supported mode and provider matrix
implementerFace: Enumerate supported and unsupported modes explicitly. Capability flags must match runtime behavior; partial support combinations must not inherit all-in-one assumptions.
reviewerFace: Check whether capability declarations and role flags are independently owned. Partial support must not force unrelated flags or reject valid combinations through shared-flag conflicts.

title: Trust and identity boundaries
implementerFace: Separate trusted provider authority from untrusted author content. Forged markers, same-author approvals, and missing permission must never become gate authority without explicit identity checks.
reviewerFace: Verify forged current-head markers and stale-head markers stay untrusted. Confirm tokens and private material never appear in summaries, logs, or evidence.

title: Freshness and cache identity
implementerFace: Key caches and evidence by exact head identity. Carry-forward and reuse paths must revalidate fragment digests and delta touch sets before treating prior approval as current.
reviewerFace: Reject stale-head evidence, carry-forward without delta checks, and approvals bound to a different SHA. Confirm local evidence and provider feedback are current-head.

title: Bounds and cancellation propagation
implementerFace: Propagate limits, page sizes, timeouts, and cancellation tokens through every page or retry loop. Fail loudly when a bound is exhausted instead of silently truncating.
reviewerFace: Look for unbounded loops, ignored pageSize/limit interactions, silent truncation at API caps, and timeouts that leave partial success without termination proof.

title: Multi-process concurrency
implementerFace: Protect shared session locks, evidence writes, and provider mutations against concurrent hosts. Prefer atomic create/replace and explicit lock owners over last-writer wins.
reviewerFace: Inspect race windows around review locks, evidence publish, and label mutations. Concurrent runs must not clobber each other's current-head artifacts.

title: Filesystem boundaries
implementerFace: Resolve fixture and evidence paths under an explicit root. Reject absolute paths, `..` traversal, and symlink escapes before any read or write.
reviewerFace: Confirm fixtureRoot/fixtureFile binding rejects path traversal and absolute escape hatches. Evidence writes must stay under the configured repository-scoped roots.

title: Serialization and encoding identity
implementerFace: Parse with strict shape checks. Do not manufacture empty titles, URLs, or arrays for missing required fields. Malformed payloads must fail loudly.
reviewerFace: Find parsers that accept partial objects and normalize them into plausible success values. Prefer GhMalformedOutputError-style failures over silent defaults.

title: Workspace versus shipped artifact parity
implementerFace: Keep package `files`, exports, and runtime loaders aligned so prompts, assets, and binaries resolve the same way in workspace and published installs.
reviewerFace: Check that new assets are included in package files, loaded relative to the package root, and covered by pack/asset validation tests.

title: Test oracle quality
implementerFace: For every acceptance criterion, ship a positive observation and a negative counterexample that would fail if the behavior regressed. Do not test only the happy path.
reviewerFace: Demand negative controls for false success, unbound fixtures, capability mismatches, and mutation isolation. Passing tests without behavior assertions are incomplete.
